# CRAV1 Spec Kit

> Spec-driven skills for specifying, planning, and building a change. These links are the human Markdown under docs/.

Installed skills read a compact edition of these pages, generated from the same sources and shipped as crav1-docs next to the skills. This index is for tools outside the kit.

## Start

- [Docs index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/README.md): Every human page, by type and by reader.
- [Install](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/install.md): Where the kit files go on Cursor and Claude Code.
- [First run](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/first-run.md): The short path from install to one task.
- [Method](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/concepts/method.md): The working loop, setup, and templates.

## Skills

- [crav1-spark-to-spec](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/reference/skills/crav1-spark-to-spec.md): Turn a one- or two-sentence spark into spec.md.
- [crav1-ideas-to-spec](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/reference/skills/crav1-ideas-to-spec.md): Turn a free-form pile of ideas (and any technical hunches in the same text) into a spec, diagrams, ADRs, and a chosen export format.
- [crav1-bundle-to-specs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/reference/skills/crav1-bundle-to-specs.md): Turn mixed intake (notes, diagrams, screenshots, optional code as context) into docs/system/ (including glossary.md) plus one spec slug per v0 feature.
- [crav1-existing-to-specs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/reference/skills/crav1-existing-to-specs.md): Turn a system that already exists into specs; asks repos only or repos plus a bundle, and one spec or system notes plus one spec per feature; or rechecks existing specs against the repos.
- [crav1-read-environment](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/reference/skills/crav1-read-environment.md): Read the host the user named.
- [crav1-fix-bug](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/reference/skills/crav1-fix-bug.md): Name one real bug the user already named.
- [crav1-create-feature-branch](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/reference/skills/crav1-create-feature-branch.md): Create or check out feat/<slug> (one branch for spec+build) or spec/<slug> (specify-only; build later on feat/<slug>).
- [crav1-review-architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/reference/skills/crav1-review-architecture.md): Start the crav1-review-architecture-agent subagent on the current spec.
- [crav1-tighten-spec](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/reference/skills/crav1-tighten-spec.md): Walk an existing spec issue-by-issue.
- [crav1-resolve-open-questions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/reference/skills/crav1-resolve-open-questions.md): Walk Open questions and Conflict lines in spec.md one by one.
- [crav1-show-or-ask-open-questions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/reference/skills/crav1-show-or-ask-open-questions.md): Show the cross-spec overview of open questions (read-only), or draft them to ask; asks which.
- [crav1-record-approval](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/reference/skills/crav1-record-approval.md): Record a named person's yes on an Approval needed item, after accept in this run.
- [crav1-add-to-spec](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/reference/skills/crav1-add-to-spec.md): Bring new information into existing specs; asks what you have: a fact, a dump, a code change, or a meeting.
- [crav1-plan-from-spec](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/reference/skills/crav1-plan-from-spec.md): Turn an accepted spec into a file-level plan.md and independently testable tasks.md.
- [crav1-review-plan](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/reference/skills/crav1-review-plan.md): Start the crav1-plan-reviewer-agent subagent on plan.md and tasks.md against spec.md.
- [crav1-tighten-plan](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/reference/skills/crav1-tighten-plan.md): Walk plan.md/tasks.md issues one by one (including /crav1-review-plan P#s).
- [crav1-build-tasks](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/reference/skills/crav1-build-tasks.md): Build tasks from tasks.md, always in an isolated worker per task; asks which tasks (one, a range, or all).
- [crav1-build-features](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/reference/skills/crav1-build-features.md): Serial board: build several ready specs one slug after another in this checkout.
- [crav1-build-walk](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/reference/skills/crav1-build-walk.md): Walk one work branch from build through merge, with one Next while it runs.
- [crav1-verify-build-against-spec](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/reference/skills/crav1-verify-build-against-spec.md): Map every v0 acceptance line to tests or UI checks and report pass, fail, or missing.
- [crav1-fix-build-gaps](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/reference/skills/crav1-fix-build-gaps.md): Fix gaps a build left, one at a time inside the spec; asks verify-report gaps or live-site gaps.
- [crav1-finalize-commit](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/reference/skills/crav1-finalize-commit.md): Draft the commit message, then commit, copy, change, or stop.
- [crav1-open-pr](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/reference/skills/crav1-open-pr.md): Open a pull request for the current change branch, or push to an existing one and update its description or comment (push with explicit yes).
- [crav1-host-setup](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/reference/skills/crav1-host-setup.md): Change one Azure DevOps or GitHub setting that does not live in the repo, through a checked-in script applied after a yes and read back live.
- [crav1-review-pr](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/reference/skills/crav1-review-pr.md): Read one named open pull request and report whether it can ship.
- [crav1-pr-status](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/reference/skills/crav1-pr-status.md): Show where one pull request stands, point by point, and who owes the next step.
- [crav1-merge-pr](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/reference/skills/crav1-merge-pr.md): Merge one named pull request with a merge commit.
- [crav1-help](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/reference/skills/crav1-help.md): Answer questions about the kit from its own local docs, with the source file and anchor for every answer.
- [crav1-update-kit](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/reference/skills/crav1-update-kit.md): Update the installed kit on the current branch to a published release.
- [crav1-tasks-ready-to-build](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/reference/skills/crav1-tasks-ready-to-build.md): List the tasks ready to build, for one spec or all, and why the others are blocked. Rewrites each slice build map.
- [crav1-explain-existing-system](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/reference/skills/crav1-explain-existing-system.md): Read the system notes spark, ideas, intake, match, or existing-to-specs already wrote (docs/system/).
- [crav1-explain-this-code](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/reference/skills/crav1-explain-this-code.md): Explain one piece of code (a file, a function, a selection, or a PR diff) from reading it.
- [crav1-explain-tech](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/reference/skills/crav1-explain-tech.md): Explain one technology (what it is, how it works, where the specs use it, why, the tradeoff, one alternative).
- [crav1-retire-spec](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/reference/skills/crav1-retire-spec.md): Take one spec out of the work (retire, merge, park, or convert to note), or un-park it.
- [crav1-what-do-we-know-about-this](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/reference/skills/crav1-what-do-we-know-about-this.md): Answer one question about a feature, slice, resource, or not-yet-feature from the specs first.
- [crav1-model-data](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/reference/skills/crav1-model-data.md): Build or revise one data model from the project's specs, with a manual flow or an auto flow.
- [crav1-design-architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/reference/skills/crav1-design-architecture.md): Work out an architecture change with the user, one decision at a time, in a sandbox until go-ahead.
- [crav1-update-specs-from-changes-and-prs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/reference/skills/crav1-update-specs-from-changes-and-prs.md): Sweep linked repos for changed branches and open or recently closed pull requests, and feed them into the specs.
- [crav1-tighten-and-plan-ready-to-build](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/reference/skills/crav1-tighten-and-plan-ready-to-build.md): Walk a draft spec through architecture, tighten, questions, and the plan until the ready check is clear.
- [crav1-refresh-system-notes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/reference/skills/crav1-refresh-system-notes.md): Update the picture in docs/system/ when something was added: add what is new to the short description, the diagram, and how the parts connect, and do not rewrite what is there.
- [crav1-map-pipeline-environments](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/reference/skills/crav1-map-pipeline-environments.md): Read Azure DevOps pipeline definitions for the org and project the user named.
- [crav1-review-security](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/reference/skills/crav1-review-security.md): Ask whether the thing in front of you is secure, after architecture already exists (docs/system/ or a spec that already describes the design).
- [crav1-glossary](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/reference/skills/crav1-glossary.md): Show the project glossary, answer one term, or fill the rows still `to be researched`.
- [crav1-export-spec](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/reference/skills/crav1-export-spec.md): Re-project an existing canonical spec.md into EARS, BDD, OpenSpec, YAML, JSON, and/or BMAD.
- [crav1-ado-sync](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/reference/skills/crav1-ado-sync.md): Keep specs and Azure Boards in step; asks suggest Features, push Features, push tasks, pull tasks, or pull spec changes.
- [crav1-run-exploratory-test](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/reference/skills/crav1-run-exploratory-test.md): After a build of a slice already exists, use the slice in two passes and write down bugs.
- [crav1-suggest-tests-for-code](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/reference/skills/crav1-suggest-tests-for-code.md): The user points at code that already exists, one repo or one area, not the whole system.

## Subagents

- [crav1-spec-reviewer-agent](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/reference/skills.md): Independent product and spec critique.
- [crav1-review-architecture-agent](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/reference/skills.md): Hunches versus decisions, diagrams, and ADRs.
- [crav1-plan-reviewer-agent](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/reference/skills.md): Plan and tasks against the spec.
- [crav1-build-task-agent](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/reference/skills.md): One `T#` from implement to commit, in isolation.
- [crav1-bundle-slice-agent](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/reference/skills.md): One v0 feature slug after the intake map.

## Concepts and rules

- [Glossary](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/concepts/glossary.md): Words the kit uses in its skills and docs. Abbreviations are written in full first. Where a word is a folder or a file, Data layout has the details.
- [Data layout](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/concepts/data-layout.md): This page lists every folder and file the kit reads or writes in a product repo, and which command writes it. It also lists the marks the kit adds inside tho...
- [Data policy for imported sources](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/concepts/data-policy.md): When a skill quotes an imported source into a spec (a mail, a transcript, minutes, a chat, a screenshot, a diagram, or another original file), it keeps the o...
- [The method](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/concepts/method.md): This page is the method behind the kit: how the pieces fit together, the six ways in, the working loop once a spec exists, how to set it up, and the best pra...
- [Skills reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/reference/skills.md): Every /crav1-… command and every subagent in the kit, grouped by lane. Each command says what it reads and what it writes. Writes lists every side effect, so...
- [Workflow routes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/reference/workflow.md): Kit version: 1.204.0
- [The one written source for the order of kit commands.](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/reference/workflow.yaml): routes:
- [Standing rules, in full](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/reference/standing-rules.md): The always-loaded rule, crav1.mdc, keeps only the rules every session needs, in short form (1.157.0). This page holds each of those rules in full, with its e...
- [How a run ends](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/reference/run-ending.md): Every skill ends a run in this shape (1.122.0). The skill still chooses which step is now, by the rules it already has. This page is only the shape.
- [Running a kit script](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/reference/running-scripts.md): A kit script is a .py file a skill names, next to that skill. Pick the interpreter (1.144.0). Stop at the first one that runs the script.
- [Question cards](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/reference/question-cards.md): A question card is one question in the questions tool (1.130.0). A batch confirm uses the same card.
- [Opening another kit skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/reference/open-skill-file.md): A kit skill with disable-model-invocation: true is command-only. It runs when a person types its slash command. Since 1.88.0 that is the usual frontmatter. 1...
- [Shared pull-request steps](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/reference/pr-common.md): /crav1-open-pr, /crav1-merge-pr, /crav1-pr-status and /crav1-review-pr share these steps (1.158.0). Each skill's SKILL.md points here and keeps only its own...
- [Generated by scripts/gen-skill-docs.py from skills.yaml. Do not edit.](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/reference/index.yaml): skills:
- [Guild routing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/guild-routing.md): For what each skill reads and writes, see the skills reference. This file maps each /crav1-… skill and *-agent subagent to a lane — Specify, Plan, Build, or...
- [Environment marks](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/environments-marks.md): /crav1-read-environment reads docs/environments/marks.md in the project repo after the resource name, the group, and the tags. It creates that folder and fil...
- [Promotion lines](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/v1.204.0/docs/environments-promotion.md): docs/environments/promotion.md says which branch deploys to which environment, so status can show how far merged work has got (since 1.69.0). It sits next to...
